foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat statutory filing fee of $155.00 for the Application for Certificate of Authority (11 V.S.A. § 4112); online registration carries no extra fee.
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report with the Secretary of State each year to maintain the certificate of authority.

evidence.quote: Application for Certificate of Authority 11 V.S.A. § 4112 $155.00
A foreign limited liability company may apply for a certificate of authority to transact business in this State by delivering an application to the Secretary of State for filing.

If you are an existing out-of-state LLC (regardless of additional elections) and wish to do business in Vermont, you will need to obtain a Certificate of Authority from the Office of the Secretary of State.
Online registration is the preferred method. There is no extra fee for online registration.

notes: Collected on the VPN-up route. The Secretary of State's fee schedule lists the foreign LLC Application for Certificate of Authority at $155.00 (11 V.S.A. § 4112) and the foreign LLC annual report at $170.00 (11 V.S.A. § 4033); the ongoing-obligation note names the annual report without restating the fee. The application must be accompanied by a certificate of existence or similar document from the home jurisdiction (11 V.S.A. § 4112(c)).
